name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills, distributed across repos and dev containers from a single source of truth.

plugins.name: local-backlog
plugins.description: Scaffold a personal, git-excluded local backlog (BACKLOG.local.md) in the current repo, and wire the maintenance convention into CLAUDE.local.md.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan, decision, or idea with a round-based interview: numbered questions with a recommended answer each, facts looked up rather than asked, and a confirmation gate. Never writes code.

plugins.name: domain-modeling
plugins.description: Build and sharpen a repo's domain language: challenge and sharpen terms, write GLOSSARY.md inline with Eric Evans (board-eric) reviewing every write, and keep a settled-term record so closed naming debates stay closed.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Record architecture decisions only when they clear three gates (hard to reverse, surprising without context, a real trade-off), in the repo's own ADR convention or a minimal docs/adr/ default.

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Build a throwaway prototype (a clickable logic demo or radically different UI variants) to settle one design question that talking can't. Hands it over and waits: the verdict is always the user's, and it never builds the real thing.
